Action.description: An action, possibly with a namespace (e.g. Infra::Action::"delete_vm").

AttrValue.description: Attribute values that can be attached to Cedar entities.

id.description: Optional client-provided identifier for this request

AuthRequest.description: Single authorization request with optional client-provided ID

requests.description: List of authorization requests to evaluate, subject to the server's configured batch limit.

AuthorizeResponse.description:
Container for authorization response results with metadata

Generic over the decision type to support both brief and detailed responses.
All fields are private; use accessor methods to retrieve data.

results.description: Results for each request with optional client IDs

version.description: Policy version used for all evaluations

oneOf.description: Brief response with minimal decision information
Detailed response with full decision reasoning

AuthorizeResponseVariant.description:
Response from the authorize endpoint - either brief or detailed based on query parameter

Uses tagged serde enum to deserialize into the correct variant.

result.description: Brief authorization decision response with minimal information

BatchResult_AuthorizeDecisionBrief.description: Result of a single batch evaluation - either success or failure

result.description: Detailed authorization decision including the matching policy

BatchResult_AuthorizeDecisionDetailed.description: Result of a single batch evaluation - either success or failure

BundleMetadata.description: Metadata for the complete bundle that produced the active policy state.

CedarIp.description: An IP address or network accepted by Cedar's `ip()` extension.

DecisionBrief.description: Brief authorization decision without policy details

Endpoint.description: Network endpoint URL for policy or label service communication

allOf.description: Result of the evaluation (success or error)

id.description: Client-provided identifier for this request (if provided)

index.description: Index of the request in the original batch

IndexedResult_AuthorizeDecisionBrief.description: A single result from a batch operation with its original index and optional client ID

index.description: Index of the request in the original batch

IndexedResult_AuthorizeDecisionDetailed.description: A single result from a batch operation with its original index and optional client ID

PermitPolicy.description: A permit policy that permitted a specific action on a resource.

PoliciesMetadata.description: Metadata about the policies and labels in the policy store

PolicyMatch.description: Match metadata for one listed policy.

PolicyMatchReason.description: Why a policy was selected by list policies APIs.

PolicyVersion.description: Version metadata for the complete engine state used during an evaluation.

generation.description: Monotonic generation within this engine instance.

hash.description: Hash of the policy source (e.g. SHA-256 of the policy text).

oneOf.description: Application-defined label-set version, when the installed registry has one.

loaded_at.description: When this policy set was loaded into the engine.

Principal.description: A principal for a policy query.

QualifiedId.description: A fully qualified, validated identifier with its parsed Cedar UID cached.

Request.description: The API-level request, with strongly-typed principal, action, groups, resource, and context.

Resource.description: A resource entity in the Cedar policy model.

attrs.description: Arbitrary attributes to attach to the resource entity

id.description: Entity id (quotes are added when rendering the Cedar literal)

kind.description: Entity type, possibly namespaced: e.g. "Host", "Gateway", or "Database::Table"

anyOf.description: Wrapper containing a Cedar schema encoded as a JSON string

SchemaUpload.description: A Cedar schema supplied as either a JSON wrapper or a raw JSON document

User.description: A user principal, possibly with a namespace (e.g. Application::User::"alice").

UserPolicies.description: Policies associated with a specific user

access_token.description: Opaque operator-provided Bearer token. Required for /api/v1/** and /metrics only when TREETOP_ACCESS_TOKENS is configured.

upload_token.name: X-Upload-Token
upload_token.description: Token printed at startup when uploads are enabled
